Date: Fri, 28 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: INV-889 — next steps for payment routing and VAT docs

Hi Marta,

Hope you had a good week. Quick follow on INV-889 (due 12/01) — our finance team flagged that we haven’t received a remittance confirmation for this invoice. Can you confirm which payment path BlueLeaf prefers (ACH, wire, or virtual card)? If ACH, please confirm the originating entity and account name so we can match the payment. If wire, we’ll provide the beneficiary details and wire reference.

Also, since this invoice is for services delivered to your EU entity, we need a copy of the VAT registration or VAT-exempt certificate for your remit entity to keep on file. You can reply with the PDF or upload to the Drive folder here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cINV889

I’ve attached the invoice PDF for ease (INV-889-Redwood-202511.pdf).

If helpful, we can offer a 2% early-pay option for payment completed by 2025-12-04 — let me know if you’d like that captured.

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@blueleaf.co>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Dec 2025 10:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: INV-889 — next steps for payment routing and VAT docs

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the heads up. We had a card decline on our end when the billing attempted yesterday; AP prefers to push via ACH but our treasury requires a VAT certificate to be attached to the payment record. I’m attaching BlueLeaf-VAT-2025.pdf (internal copy).

Can you confirm your ACH receiving account + the exact reference string we should include? If ACH takes longer on your side, we can route a wire this week — which is faster for us.

Best,
Marta
Marta Ruiz
Head of Accounts Payable, BlueLeaf Ltd.
Attachments: BlueLeaf-VAT-2025.pdf
